Based on this observation, I would suggest updating the `__init__` method of the Progbar class to initialize `current` to 1 instead of 0. This should resolve the off-by-one error and fix the failing test case.

The issue seems to be related to an off-by-one error when initializing the progress bar's current value. Updating the initialization of `current` in the Progbar class from 0 to 1 should fix the problem.
